title: Blaschke--Santaló inequalities with respect to costs
summary: We study functional Blaschke--Santaló inequalities in which the inner product is replaced by a cost. An inequality on each orthant, combined with Steiner symmetrization, gives a sufficient condition for a cost inequality to hold for even convex functions. We apply this principle to a multiplicative cost defined on all orthants. Its second variation gives a weighted improvement of the Brascamp--Lieb inequality in the directions for which differentiation is justified.
